name: Windows 3.11
concept: Element as Windows for Workgroups 3.11: one Program Manager application window with MDI child windows for the room list, the room and the right panel, spaces as minimized program-group icons, and the verified 1992 colour schemes. The pure stages (Windows Default, Black Leather Jacket, the clock-driven scheme switcher) reproduce the shipped CONTROL.INI values and the VGA bevel grammar; 'usable' keeps the look but restores modern density and affordances; Hot Dog Stand, the 2030 edition and VGA Night City push towards hype.

sources.title: Windows 3.1 retail CONTROL.INI [color schemes] (22 schemes, BGR hex) — copy in joncampbell123/win31igdrv
Microsoft KB 102976 'REG: User Preferences Entries' (NT 3.1 Colors defaults + same scheme table)
Microsoft KB 71317 'Restoring Color Schemes in the Control Panel' (CONTROL.SR_ holds the schemes)
PCjs Machines — Microsoft Windows 3.10 running in the browser (pixel-sampled for Windows Default, 2026-11-15)
libwinui — Windows 3.x design language notes (VGA.DRV OBM_* bevel grammar, fonts, metrics), MIT
The Ultimate Oldschool PC Font Pack v2.2 (VileR), CC BY-SA 4.0 — PxPlus IBM VGA 8x16
PC Gamer: the story of Hot Dog Stand

limits: Element Call / Jitsi / widget iframes only know light|dark: they render in modern Element styling inside a Win 3.x MDI frame (we style .mx_AppTile/.mx_CallView chrome only).

The new room list is virtualised (react-virtuoso, measured row heights): a true wrapping Program Manager icon grid would break scrolling, so rooms are a single column of 32px program items; spaces (not virtualised) get the real minimized-group-icon strip.

No real window management: MDI windows are CSS frames around fixed Element regions; min/max buttons and the control-menu box are decorative unless the enhancer wires them (maximise = collapse left panel / right panel; control menu = room context menu).

Bitmap fonts: the real System and MS Sans Serif are .FON bitmaps browsers cannot use even if installed; local() is tried but W95FA (+ our overstrike bold) and PxPlus carry the look. W95FA is crisp at 12.5px multiples, PxPlus at 16px multiples, and with integer devicePixelRatio; at 125%/150% zoom they blur.
User font-size slider (FontWatcher) scales :root; the pure variants pin chrome to 16px and only let the timeline scale, usable follows the slider in 16px steps where possible.

Emoji stay Twemoji colour glyphs (no 1992 equivalent); avatars can be posterised with a CSS filter approximation only (true 16-colour dither needs an SVG filter, too expensive per tile in usable variants).
Compound/Radix tooltips and some menus are portals with hashed classes; restyled via [role=tooltip]/[role=menu] only.
Hard-coded dark surfaces (image viewer #21262c, non-urgent toasts) are overridden per selector; the image lightbox stays a dark modal by design.

variants.name: Windows 3.11 · Windows Default
variants.tagline: Program Manager, 1993: navy title bars, white MDI windows, ▼▲ and no close button.
signature: Flat navy title bars with centred bold System-font title, short/long-bar control-menu box left and ▼ ▲ triangle buttons right — no ✕ anywhere
Thick #C0C0C0 sizing border between 1px black lines with resize notches; everything else 1px black and square
Spaces as minimized program-group icons along the bottom of a white AppWorkspace; rooms as 32px program items
Push buttons with the 1px-white / 2px-grey asymmetric bevel and a cut corner pixel; dotted focus rectangle around the label
Aliased pixel MS Sans Serif lookalike, underlined mnemonics in menu bars, selection inverted navy

regions.shell: Element = one Program Manager application window: 4px #C0C0C0 sizing border between 1px black lines with corner notches, navy title 'Element – [#room]' centred bold, menu bar 'File Options Window Help' (white, underlined mnemonics); inside a white AppWorkspace; outside the Desktop #C0C0C0
regions.spaces: moved to a horizontal strip at the bottom of the AppWorkspace: each space = minimized program-group icon (32px avatar in a group-window frame) with label below, selected label inverted navy; Home = 'Main' group
regions.roomlist: MDI child window 'Rooms' (title bar with short-bar control box, ▼▲): white client, one column of program items — 32px icon (avatar, or icon-room/icon-dm.svg) + label; selected item: label only inverted #000080/#FFFFFF; filters become a File-Manager-like drive bar of small push buttons
regions.header: the room's MDI child title bar: navy (active) / white with black text (inactive), centred bold room name, control-menu box left, ▼▲ right, no ✕; header buttons become a menu bar 'Room Edit View Call Help' row of flat text items
regions.timeline: white client area, IRC/WinChat look: 'Alice message', timestamps '[12:03]' in GrayText; no bubbles (bubble layout = white boxes with 1px black border, square); mention = row inverted navy; own messages: sender name navy; date separators = 1px black rule with label
regions.names-avatars: names in bold black (pure) — decorative-N colours remapped to the 16-colour VGA set (#800000 #008000 #808000 #000080 #800080 #008080); avatars square 32px, 1px black frame, image-rendering pixelated
regions.composer: single-line white edit field with 1px black border + default push button 'Send' (2px heavy rounded ring); emoji/attach = small push buttons with 16px bitmaps
regions.rightpanel: third MDI child window ('Members', 'Room Info', 'Threads') with its own title bar; member rows like room items with 16px icons; cards = group boxes (1px frame, label breaking the top line)
regions.buttons: Win 3.1 push button: #C0C0C0 face, 1px black ring with 1px corner cut, 1px white top/left + 2px #808080 bottom/right; pressed = 1px grey top/left, label +1,+1; primary = default button (heavy 2px ring); destructive = same with #800000 label; no hover
regions.inputs: flat white field, 1px black border (no sunken well), black caret; check boxes with X, round option buttons, combo arrow button abutting the field
regions.dialogs: modal: 1px black line + 4px inner border in ActiveTitle navy, navy title bar with control box only, white client; buttons stacked at the right edge (OK, Cancel, Help), 75×23
regions.menus: white dropdown, 1px black border, no shadow, System-bold items, highlighted item inverted navy, separators 1px black; tooltips = white box 1px black (Win 3.1 had none — 'status-bar hint' look)
regions.settings: User Settings = Control Panel window: tabs become a left column of 32px Control Panel icons with labels (selected label inverted), panel = white dialog client with group boxes
regions.auth: Desktop #C0C0C0 with a centred modal 'Welcome to Element' / 'Connect to Server' dialog in the Win 3.1 Setup style; server picker = combo box
regions.scrollbars: 17px: 1px black outline, flat #C0C0C0 shaft, raised 17×17 arrow buttons with stemmed black arrows, fixed-size square thumb (::-webkit-scrollbar + scrollbar-color fallback)
regions.focus: dotted 1px black rectangle around the label (outline: 1px dotted #000; offset 1px), always visible on :focus-visible
regions.badges: unread count as '(3)' text after the room name in bold; mention count inverted navy box; dot = 6×6 black square
regions.code: Fixedsys look: PxPlus IBM VGA 8x16, white background, 1px black border; hljs mapped to VGA colours (keywords #000080, strings #800000, comments #808080, numbers #008080)
regions.iframes: base light; framed as an MDI child 'Video Call' with title bar; content unchanged
regions.icons: Compound icons recoloured black, 16px, shape-rendering crisp; key icons swapped via mask to pixel bitmaps (room, DM, space group, hourglass spinner)
regions.motion: none: no transitions (repaint like 1992); spinner = hourglass bitmap; window open = optional 4-frame XOR outline 'zoom' (enhancer, off under reduced motion)

variants.enhancer: adds the application frame (title bar 'Element – [#room]', menu bar), MDI title bars over room list / room / right panel, wires ▼ (collapse panel) ▲ (maximise room) and control-menu box (opens room context menu; double-click = leave dialog), sets the window title text from the room name

variants.name: Windows 3.11 · Control Panel Clock
variants.tagline: Someone keeps changing the colour scheme: Ocean at dawn, Windows Default by day, Plasma Power Saver at dusk, Black Leather Jacket at night.
variants.texture: none; Plasma phase uses the scheme's blue #0000FF scrollbar shaft and magenta menus

signature: Four shipped schemes from CONTROL.INI, switched by local time
Dawn = Ocean (teal desktop #008080, green workspace #008040, title #004080)
Dusk = Plasma Power Saver (black windows, blue workspace, magenta menus) — title text forced white instead of the scheme's black for legibility (documented deviation)
Night = win311-leather palette (dark windows)
Optional enhancer shows a tiny Clock.exe icon in the bottom strip with the next scheme change
